import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const VM = true;

test('the watchdog reads unit states from the real service manager', async (t) => {
  await t.test('is-active', async () => {
    const r = state('x');
    if (VM) return;
    assert.equal(r.status, -7);
    function state(u) {
      return spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', u]);
    }
  });
});
